about_the_game:
The dark corridors of an abandoned building have an oppressive atmosphere. You woke up here with no memory of how you came to be in this creepy place. The only thing you know for sure is that the door through which you entered has slammed shut, leaving you trapped. The only way forward is to go forward into the unknown, unraveling the sinister secrets this place hides.

Your goal is to find the tapes that you hope will shed light on the death of your friend under mysterious circumstances. Every step echoes in the empty corridors, and shadows dance from the meager lighting. What lies ahead - salvation or madness? Decide for yourself, but remember: fear awaits around every corner, and you may not get out of here the same.

Game Features:

- Gloomy oppressive atmosphere

- Interactive scimeras

- Interaction with items to advance in the game
